topic: What metrics quantify the efficiency gains of satellite multicast over terrestrial unicast for high-demand content distribution?
consensus_response: Satellite multicast efficiency gains over terrestrial unicast can be quantified by metrics that evaluate resource utilization, power consumption, and bandwidth allocation. The Average Unused Offered Capacity (AUOC), Average Used Carrier (AUC), Average Used Power (AUP), and Average Used Bandwidth (AUB) are essential metrics to measure these aspects. Optimizing AUOC reduces resource wastage, while AUC and AUP indicate efficient resource utilization and power consumption. AUB quantifies the trade-off between bandwidth allocation and content delivery costs. These metrics interact with each other, and optimizing one metric can impact others.
